# Stratus Aerial — RCCA Test Tracker

https://stratus-rcca-tracker.vercel.app

A test-execution and root-cause tracking dashboard for a **fictional** autonomous
drone-robotaxi company. Built to demonstrate how I run test coordination, failure
triage, and root-cause/corrective-action (RCCA) workflows — the day-to-day of a
test operations role, as working software instead of resume bullets.

**All data is synthetic**, generated by `generate_data.py` (seeded, reproducible).
No real company data, tooling, or incidents are represented.

---

## Why this exists

Test coordination roles ask for the same core claims: coordinate testing pipelines,
follow up on execution failures, identify root causes, report on data integrity.
This project is those claims as running code:

| Role claim | Where it lives |
|---|---|
| Coordinate online/offline testing pipelines | **Test Runs** — filterable execution log across Simulation / HIL Bench / Flight |
| Follow up on execution failures | **Failure Triage** — severity-ranked queue, aging indicators, Open → Investigating → Corrective Action → Verified workflow |
| Identify reasons, follow up with teams | **RCCA Analytics** — occurrence-weighted root-cause Pareto, failures by owning team, 5-Whys captured per failure |
| Data integrity reporting | **Reports** — artifact-completeness audit (logs / telemetry / video per run) |
| Communicate results | **Reports** — weekly pass-rate trend by pipeline + generated end-of-day report with copy-to-clipboard |

## The stories seeded in the data

Synthetic data is honest about being synthetic — but it's *designed*, not random.
Three narrative arcs are seeded so the RCCA workflow has something real to show:

1. **The sim-only crosswind failure (Scenario Definition).** "Precision Landing —
   Gusty Crosswind" fails chronically in Simulation while the *same scenario passes
   in Flight* — the signature of a test-config problem, not a vehicle problem.
   The 5-Whys chain lands on a unit mismatch: the scenario config supplies gust
   speed in m/s; the wind service reads knots. Corrective action: schema unit
   validation plus an audit of legacy-derived configs.

2. **The telemetry gap cluster (Data / Logging).** Flight runs in a three-week
   window are missing telemetry ~40% of the time — visible as a cluster in the
   artifact-integrity report, traced to an uploader race on rapid disarm.

3. **A genuine regression (Software Regression).** Builds v2.15.0/.1 spike
   "Obstacle Avoidance — Dynamic Intruder" failures on HIL and Flight. The weekly
   trend chart shows the dip and the recovery after v2.15.2 ships. Verified closed,
   with a corrective action that adds the missing case to the pre-merge perf suite.

## Architecture decisions

- **No backend, no database.** Data is generated by a Python script into JSON,
  imported at build time. The thing being demonstrated is RCCA *workflow design*,
  not CRUD plumbing — a backend would spend effort proving the wrong claim.
- **"Today" is anchored to the dataset's last date**, so failure aging is
  deterministic and honest for static data.
- **Occurrence-weighted Pareto.** A failure seen 9 times counts 9, not 1 —
  corrective effort should follow recurrence, not ticket count. Uncategorized
  failures are excluded: you can't Pareto what you haven't root-caused.
- **Artifact requirements vary by pipeline** — video is n/a for Simulation runs,
  so the integrity audit doesn't produce false alarms.
- **Functional React + hooks throughout.** State lives in `useState`/`useMemo`;
  the triage stepper mutates a state copy of the failure list.
- **Light and dark themes, system-aware.** The preference persists in
  `localStorage` and "Auto" follows the OS live; the theme resolves before first
  paint, so there's no flash of the wrong one on load.

## Run it

```bash
npm install
npm run dev        # local dev server
npm run build      # production build
npm run data       # regenerate the synthetic dataset (python3)
```

## Stack

React 18 · Vite · Recharts · Python 3 (data generation) ·
IBM Plex Mono / Space Grotesk / IBM Plex Sans
